items.name: Introdução
items.content: {"json":"## CodeRats · Saúde e volume\nDados reais de **AppRequests** no Log Analytics. A ausência de dados indica que a instrumentação precisa ser verificada; não equivale a zero chamadas. Filtre períodos no Azure Workbook e compare versões com janelas equivalentes."}

items.name: Resumo por serviço
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend Servico = iff(isempty(AppRoleName), "nao-instrumentado-com-service.name", AppRoleName)
| summarize Chamadas=count(), Falhas=countif(Success == false), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1) by Servico
| extend TaxaErro_pct=round(100.0*Falhas/Chamadas, 2)
| order by Chamadas desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Chamadas ao longo do tempo
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend Servico = iff(isempty(AppRoleName), "sem-role", AppRoleName)
| summarize Chamadas=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Servico
| order by TimeGenerated asc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"timechart","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Endpoints mais chamados
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Chamadas=count(), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),1), Falhas=countif(Success == false) by Endpoint=Name
| top 30 by Chamadas desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Erro por serviço
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Total=count(), Erros=countif(Success == false) by AppRoleName, ResultCode
| order by Erros desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}
